newsitem.title: USA: Vital Signs to acquire Marquest.
newsitem.headline: Vital Signs to acquire Marquest.

text.p: Vital Signs Inc, Marquest Medical Products Inc and Scherer Healthcare Inc said on Friday that Vital Signs agreed to acquire Marquest.
The companies said in a joint statement that Vital Signs, a Totowa-based maker of disposable anesthesia products, would pay Marquest holders $0.797 per share for each share of stock.
Vital Signs agreed to acquire from Scherer Healthcare, the majority holder of Marquest, certain product rights previously sold by Marquest to Scherer for $6 million, the companies said.
The aggregate cash payments to Marquest's shareholders will be approximately $12.6 million, the companies said.
The deals, which are expected to close in June 1997, are subject to shareholder approvals and other conditions, the companies said.

Also, Vital Signs entered into a two year distribution agreement effective March 14, 1997 to distribute Marquest's products through the Vital Signs sales force on a national basis, the companies said.

Englewood, Colo.-based Marquest is a manufacturer and international distributor of specialty cardiopulmonary support, respiratory and anesthesia disposable devices. Atlanta-based Scherer makes disposable anesthesia and respiratory products.
